thumbnail.description: Deprecated image field kept for old documents; use `icon` or `cover`.

agentServerUrl.description: The agents server this space advertises to its readers (an http(s) origin); clients connect to it beside their own servers.

spaceAgents.description: Agents this space publishes to its readers: `{[agentId]: order}`, each id an agent on `agentServerUrl`; a removed agent leaves a null behind.

attributesSchema.description: The attributes schema THIS document conforms to: the hm:// URL of a schema document (or ipfs://<cid> of a schema blob) whose struct describes the document's attributes.

childAttributesSchema.description: The attributes schema this document's direct CHILDREN conform to (hm:// URL or ipfs://<cid>). A child may declare its own `attributesSchema` instead.

schemaDefinition.description: This document DEFINES a schema: ipfs://<cid> of the schema blob it describes. Its target is the meta-schema, so an editor creates and validates the blob as a Hypermedia schema (the struct form, rooted at Struct by default). Other documents reference this document's URL as their `attributesSchema`/`childAttributesSchema`.

seedExperimentalHomeOrder.description: Legacy ordering of a space home listing.

importCategories.description: Comma-separated categories kept from an external import (e.g. WordPress).

importTags.description: Comma-separated tags kept from an external import (e.g. WordPress).
